contentText: Russia intercepted 1,336 drones launched by Ukraine, Russia’s Defense Ministry said Monday, in what was the most claimed downings since Moscow’s all-out invasion of its neighbor nearly five years ago. Russia, meanwhile, has battered Ukrainian civilian areas with relentless strikes that seek to choke the economy and break public morale, in attacks President Volodymyr Zelensky said were made possible ⁠partly due to restrictions on Ukraine's use of SpaceX's Starshield service.
